verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents an API with keys and access (anythingllm-docs-11) and a custom agent skill developer guide (anythingllm-docs-12), showing programmatic access exists beyond the UI, but there is no evidence of a published OpenAPI spec (probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404'd) or documentation claiming full UI/API feature parity. missing for 10: explicit parity documentation showing every UI action is API-accessible, a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent confirmation from users that the API covers the same surface as the UI.
